title: Frost Walker: Enhanced
description: Enhance the Frost Walker enchantment, by upgrading it to level III - Fixes a lot of issues with the Frost Walker enchantment, adds new utilities.
body:
# Frost Walker: Enhanced

This mod allows you to enhance your Frost Walker experience on your world.

The following features are:
- Mob riding (Allows you to ride: horses, pigs, donkeys, mules, camels and striders on ice.),
- Sprint jumping (Allows you to sprint-jump on the ice, a feature normally not possible in Vanilla.),
- Gives a speed boost when using the Frost Walker III enchantment,
- Adds a new Frost Walker III tier.


## Usage:

Put the Frost Walker I-III (Adds a new tier ,,III'') on your boots, and enjoy your smooth usage of it.

## Bug reporting:

- You can report bugs by sending me a message on Discord: houstonp901 - I accept & read message requests.
